protocol.status: Exploratory follow-up defined before these fits; original test runs have already been inspected. Not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
protocol.data: Reuse original 32 independent n=26, nu=.02, dt=.005 simulations; original 16/8/8 run splits and five anchors, .2 lookback, .025 gap, .2 horizon, k=8. No new simulations.
protocol.mirror: R=diag(-1,1,1). Consistent reflection x'=xR, u'=uR, J'=RJR. Time reversal reorders only observed past positions and retains original current neighbor selection. Neither is backward viscous dynamics.
protocol.current_chirality: For current neighbor offsets r, d=|r| and v=r/d, form m_j=mean_k[(d/mean_k(d))^j v], j=0,1,2. c=det(rows m_j)/product_j |m_j| (zero when denominator <=1e-12). Translation and label invariant, rotation even, reflection odd. Distance ties excluded as in parent.
protocol.past_chirality: For each of the original current neighbors, q_k=det(rows v_start,v_middle,v_end). p=mean_k q_k. Three added features: p, mean_k |q_k|, p*c. The last compares past and present handedness and is reflection even. Temporal reversal flips p and p*c, preserves mean|q|.
models: C_shuffled: B_current_chirality + within-run/anchor shuffled 3-feature history blocks
C_mirrored_history_refit: history chirality sign transform [-1,+1,-1] with current inputs fixed; invertible representation control
C_reversed: original present inputs, reversed 23 histories, c, and reversed 3 chirality features
C_reversed_mirrored_history_refit: C_reversed with its 3 chirality features transformed [-1,+1,-1]
protocol.fit: Original train-only standardized ridge/logistic and original validation regularization search. Event cutoff from training 90th percentile. Original 2000 paired test-run bootstraps. No feature tuning after scores.
protocol.audit: All five anchors on all 32 base runs: original and reversed 23 features under consistent reflection; new signed features reflection and reversal laws; label permutation and translation; target reflection on selected tangent intervals. Report maximum discrepancies.
protocol.limits: No independent confirmation, continuum convergence, human-memory or material-memory result. Scalar FTLE is reflection invariant under a consistent complete reflection; chirality can matter relative to surrounding structure, not through an absolute preferred handedness. Refitted invertible sign transformations are not information-removal controls. History-only mirroring is not a dynamically consistent counterfactual.
